business_problem: The organization needed a more developed data management platform for their on-premises legacy environment.
solution_summary: Plenitude is a company owned by Eni that integrates production from renewables, energy sales, energy services and a large network of electric vehicle charging points. Plenitude leverages data and AI for optimized efficiency organizationwide. Migrating to the Databricks Data + AI Platform on the cloud, the company expanded data usage, enhancing operational efficiency and customer engagement through demand forecasting, segmentation and personalization. Paolo Maltese, Data & AI Platform Product Owner at Plenitude, explained, “The challenges around managing various data sources and types impacted our ability to enable downstream analytics for BI, SQL and ML for various data teams and stakeholders in terms of data product time to market, skill diffusion for data analysis and understanding, data quality and trust.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Delta Sharing
solution_components.role: Delivers governed data access across agencies, partners, or business units without copying datasets.

data_flow: Customer, product, and engagement data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables under Unity Catalog governance, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL, Delta Sharing.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 650 Users including data engineers, scientists, analysts, stewards and viewers; 100 Reports and dashboards running on Databricks; 60 Use cases implemented on Databricks.
